The [[Hammer of Kathandrax]], also called Kathandrax's Crusher, is the required [[quest item]] for completing [[Kathandrax's Crusher]].  It drops from the [[Chest of Kathandrax]], the dungeon reward chest at the end of the [[Catacombs of Kathandrax]].

==Notes==
* Despite its name and look, this is not a [[weapon]].
* If you have this quest item, you do not need to enter the catacombs to gain credit for completing ''Kathandrax's Crusher''. This has created a demand from [[Survivor]] candidates interested in risk-free [[experience point]]s.
** You would need 179 hammers to earn the 1,337,500 XP required to maximize a character's rank in the Survivor title track.
* You still need to complete the dungeon to get credit for the [[Ilsundur, Lord of Fire (Zaishen quest)]] and the [[Master Dungeon Guide]].
{{bug|A stack of two or more Hammers of Kathandrax appears singular in its description, e.g. ''"2 Hammer of Kathandrax"''.}}
==Trivia==
* The hammer shares its [[inventory]] icon and skin with the [[Break Hammer]].
